column1: # The Go commands under src-go/cmd, and what drives each one (read by qa-changed.bash and
# checked by test-qa-changed.bash: a command with no row here is a failure).
#   suites   the scripts/test-*.bash suites that build and drive the binary, space separated; they
#            run when a file in the command's build closure changes. Or qa-go: the command's oracle
#            is a Go test, which the Go gate (scripts/qa-go-qa.bash) runs on any src-go/ change
#            that reaches the command, so there is no bash suite to add.
# A command no play deploys and no one runs by hand (a QA tool) lives under src-go/qa/cmd and has
# no row. watchlist is run from the checkout with go run and is not deployed.
